meta.title: 北京四中老师：补习班超前学习，真的没必要
meta.title_en: A Beijing No.4 High School Teacher on Cram Schools

scenes.title_en: Against learning ahead of the curve
scenes.context: 北京四中老师开场直言不赞成补习班的超前学习，会让孩子失去天性。
sentences: 坦率地说，我是不赞成这种补习班的超前学习的。
To be honest, I don't support cram schools pushing students to learn ahead of the curve.
超前学习：learn ahead of the curve
提前学一些知识，对孩子来说没有太大的意义。
Learning things early doesn't mean much for a child in the long run.
没有太大意义：doesn't mean much
而且会让我们的孩子失去很多与生俱来的能力。
It also robs our children of abilities they're born with.
与生俱来的能力：inborn abilities
paraphrase: Inborn traits matter more than early progress.
scenes.speak: To be honest, I don't support cram schools pushing students to learn ahead of the curve. Learning things early doesn't mean much for a child in the long run. It also robs our children of abilities they're born with.

scenes.context: 讲者用四中状元的例子说明成绩好不靠补习班，并讲到一位谢绝采访的女状元。
sentences: 北京四中有几个高考状元，他们基本上都是没上过补习班的。
Several top scorers from my school never attended cram schools at all.
高考状元：top scorers
她非常坦然，就谢绝了所有的采访。
She stayed calm and simply turned down every interview.
谢绝采访：turn down interviews
她谈到的是一种从容的心态、一种坚定的价值。
What she talked about was a composed mindset and steady values.
从容的心态：a composed mindset
paraphrase: 心态与价值是真正的加分项
Mindset and values are the real edge.
scenes.speak: Several top scorers from my school never attended cram schools at all. She stayed calm and simply turned down every interview. What she talked about was a composed mindset and steady values.

scenes.context: 讲者点出焦虑的根源是评价机制，并主张教育朝更大范围的均衡发展。
sentences: 使孩子失去天性的，主要是我们现在这个评价的机制。
What robs children of their nature is mainly our current evaluation system.
评价机制：the evaluation system
在2013年我在全校做过一次讲话，谈未来教育的新常态。
In 2013 I gave a school-wide talk about the new normal for education.
教育的新常态：the new normal for education
我们要在更大范围内促进教育的均衡。
We should promote educational equity on a much larger scale.
教育均衡：educational equity
paraphrase: 个体抢跑解不了系统焦虑
Individual cramming can't fix systemic anxiety.
从军备竞赛到均衡发展
From an arms race to real equity.
scenes.speak: What robs children of their nature is mainly our current evaluation system. In 2013 I gave a school-wide talk about the new normal for education. We should promote educational equity on a much larger scale.

practice: Learning ahead of the curve isn't real growth.
She calmly turned down every interview.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：Children lose many abilities born with them.
✓ 地道说法：It robs children of their inborn abilities.
失去与生俱来的能力→robs children of inborn abilities。
✕ 直译腔：The top scorer refused all the reporters.
✓ 地道说法：She turned down every interview.
✕ 直译腔：A clever state of mind.
✓ 地道说法：A composed, steady mindset.
从容的心态→composed mindset，不是 clever。
✕ 直译腔：Education should develop toward balance.
✓ 地道说法：We should promote educational equity.
shifts: 把焦虑归因到孩子不努力
把焦虑归因到评价机制
footer_notes: ASR 校正：「戏剧了所有的采访」校正为「谢绝了所有的采访」、「聪明的心态」按语境校正为「从容的心态」、「好叫这样的学生」校正为「做好迎接这样学生的思想准备」；「四中」「状元」等专名保留。
